task.description: Produce the fix design for ISS-0276 per docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md Step 2. Read handoffs/WF03-ISS0276-20260822/step-01-issue-fixer.json's result.summary in full -- it is ISSUE-FIXER's complete diagnosis and 'WHAT A FIX MUST ADD' section naming the exact call chain, idempotency question, LETFLOW_DEV_DB_CONFIRMED question, and documentation requirement. Design a new Mix.Task (mix letflow.seed, matching the lib/mix/tasks/ naming convention) that provisions a default tenant (slug bpm-default, idp_realm_id bpm-default) via Letflow.Identity.create_tenant/1 -> Letflow.TenantProvisioning.provision_tenant_schema/1 -> Letflow.TenantProvisioning.replay_migrations/1. Your design must explicitly resolve: (a) the exact attrs map passed to create_tenant/1, (b) idempotency behavior when a bpm-default tenant already exists (create_tenant/1 returns {:error, :duplicate_slug} today), (c) whether/how the task interacts with the LETFLOW_DEV_DB_CONFIRMED=1 guard in lib/letflow/repo.ex, (d) where documentation of the new command goes (README.md or docs/) satisfying AC3. Design artefact only -- signatures, @specs, module/function shapes, and prose describing behavior. NO implementation code bodies.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers all 3 of ISS-0276's stated acceptance criteria (fresh-DB seed creates the row; an authenticated bpm-default-realm request then resolves a tenant; the path is documented)
Design explicitly states the mix task's module name, invocation (mix letflow.seed), and its call sequence against the three named Identity/TenantProvisioning functions
Design explicitly resolves idempotency (re-run behavior) and the LETFLOW_DEV_DB_CONFIRMED interaction -- not left as an open question for ELIXIR-DEV to invent
Design names the exact doc location and what text is added
No .ex function bodies / no compilable implementation code in the design doc -- signatures and prose only

result.summary: Design artefact written to lib/letflow/design/iss0276-dev-bootstrap-seed.md, produced from ISSUE-FIXER's step-01 diagnosis (read in full) plus direct reading of lib/letflow/identity.ex, lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex, lib/letflow/routers/tenants.ex, lib/letflow/repo.ex, config/dev.exs, an existing lib/mix/tasks/*.ex task for style precedent, and README.md's 'Running it' section for doc-insertion style. Designs Mix.Tasks.Letflow.Seed (lib/mix/tasks/letflow.seed.ex, invocation `mix letflow.seed`), calling Letflow.Identity.create_tenant/1 with %{"slug" => "bpm-default", "display_name" => "Default Tenant", "idp_realm_id" => "bpm-default"}, then Letflow.TenantProvisioning.provision_tenant_schema/1, then Letflow.TenantProvisioning.replay_migrations/1 on the resulting tenant_id -- matching POST /tenants's own chain. Explicitly resolves all four required points: (a) exact attrs map (above); (b) idempotency -- a {:error, :duplicate_slug} from create_tenant/1 is not a failure: the task resolves the existing tenant via resolve_tenant_by_realm("bpm-default") and continues the same provision/replay chain against it (already-idempotent per those functions' own docs), only Mix.raise/1-ing if resolve_tenant_by_realm/1 instead returns :not_found (a genuine slug collision with a differently-configured tenant); (c) LETFLOW_DEV_DB_CONFIRMED -- resolved as NO special-cased logic needed: config/dev.exs's require_dev_db_confirmation: true means Mix.Task.run("app.start") inside the task already triggers Letflow.Repo.init/2's existing guard before any task code runs, so the task is not exempted and needs no duplicate check; (d) documentation -- README.md 'Running it' section, new fenced `LETFLOW_DEV_DB_CONFIRMED=1 mix letflow.seed` block inserted directly after the existing ecto.setup/mix run block (before the curl health-check block), plus the task's own @moduledoc/@shortdoc as the mix-help-reachable copy. Also specifies explicit Mix.raise/1 error handling for every non-ok branch of all three calls, and lists two open questions (display_name literal choice; regression-test invocation strategy, left to TEST-DESIGNER) rather than silently deciding them. No .ex function bodies included -- signatures, @spec shapes, and prose only.
